description: Ensure a development-only GroupBy is not enabled for online serving.
prompt: Add a new development-only version of the GCP purchases GroupBy in python/test/canary/group_bys/gcp/purchases.py. The new version should keep the existing user_id key and purchase source, and add a 14-day purchase_price sum for offline experimentation. This configuration is not production ready and will not serve traffic. Make the smallest appropriate versioned change, compile it, and validate it with the Zipline eval command. Do not modify unrelated configurations.

judge_criteria: The new development-only GroupBy does not set online=True because it is not production ready or serving traffic.
The change versions the existing GroupBy instead of introducing another GroupBy for the same source and keys.
The requested 14-day purchase_price sum is suitable for offline experimentation and follows repository conventions.
Compilation and eval outcomes are reported accurately.
